data.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in three days as September selling pressure mounts
data.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs hemorrhaged roughly $450M in net outflows over three trading days from September 8-10, snapping what had been one of the strongest inflow streaks in recent memory. The selling accelerated as the week progressed, with September 10 alone accounting for $282.6M in redemptions.To p…
